title: Where The Options Market Is Pointing Next
speaker: Anthony and Shawn (Geeks of Finance)

macro_themes.view: After the summer run-up, metals likely consolidate; GLD needs to reclaim 400 for positive momentum.

calls.reason: Three layers of support (10/20-day SMA ~7,670, 50-day EMA 7,632, summer uptrend) plus large gamma above at 7,700 and bullish flows favor a bounce; Shawn sees 7,800-8,000 by year end but not new highs immediately.
calls.quote: makes us think that we're more likely to see a bounce in the near term than a larger scale sell-off.

calls.condition: Above 17 opens 20; a market rebound points to 15
calls.reason: Negative GEX between 15-17; net GEX turned negative; VIX has bottomed in the 14 zone all year.
calls.quote: for now, we need to watch out for 20 if the VIX can get above 17.

calls.condition: Needs to get back above 400; then better odds of 450
calls.reason: Broke below 50-day EMA, MAs rolling over, negative gamma; but positive net flows and big call positioning at 450 into 2027.
calls.quote: About 400 is going to be our first target.

calls.reason: Dipped from 58 to ~55, below 50-day EMA, mostly negative flows (call selling at 60); expects consolidation.
calls.quote: Our view is that there's going to be some consolidation in the metals markets.

calls.reason: Very positive GEX into earnings suggests 1,100 and possibly 1,200 despite price under the daily HMA; holds a put credit spread.
calls.quote: we do think 1,200 has a good shot of being reached.

calls.reason: Pulled back to the 10-day SMA after the Muse-driven breakout and bounced 3.26% on big bullish flows; gamma at 800 with dealer selling above it.
calls.quote: That's our ultimate target is is that 800 strike heading into October.

notes: Date: 'yesterday... big gap down... into Monday' and Micron earnings 'tomorrow after the bell' -> Tue 2026-09-29; listing said 09-30. Year-end SPX range 7,800-8,000 from Shawn; lower bound recorded as target.
